messages.message: ### Step 2: Morphosyntactic Requirement Definition Goal: For Tamil, specify per-token morphosyntax needed to realize the Step 1 Interpretation Lock. Requirements (ONE Markdown table): - Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Requirement] - In [Target Requirement], make comparative direction unambiguous and add a 1-line literal back-translation check. Output: ONLY the table; no extra prose.

| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Requirement | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------| | Tant' | Intensifier indicating a high degree of bitterness | Use adverb **மிக** before the adjective (e.g., “மிக கசப்பானது”). *Back‑translation check*: “மிக கசப்பானது” → “so bitter”. | | è (1) | Copular verb linking implicit subject “it” to predicate “bitter” | Render with Tamil copula **ஆகும்** after the predicate (e.g., “கசப்பானது ஆகும்”). *Back‑translation check*: “கசப்பானது ஆகும்” → “is bitter”. | | amara | Predicate adjective “bitter” | Translate as adjective **கசப்பான** agreeing with neuter/impersonal subject. *Back‑translation check*: “கசப்பான” → “bitter”. | | che | Comparative subordinator introducing clause of degree | Use comparative particle **விட** to mark the standard of comparison. *Back‑translation check*: “… விட …” → “than”. | | poco | Adverb “little” quantifying the degree of increase | Translate with adverb **சிறிது** placed before comparative adjective. *Back‑translation check*: “சிறிது அதிகம்” → “a little more”. | | è (2) | Copular verb in comparative clause linking “death” to comparative predicate | Same as above: **ஆகும்** after the comparative phrase. *Back‑translation check*: “மரணம் அதிகம் கசப்பானது ஆகும்” → “death is more bitter”. | | più | Comparative adverb “more” | Use comparative adjective **அதிகம்** following **சிறிது**. *Back‑translation check*: “சிறிது அதிகம்” → “a little more”. | | morte | Noun “death”, standard of comparison | Translate as **மரணம்** (noun, nominative). *Back‑translation check*: “மரணம்” → “death”. | | ma | Coordinating conjunction “but” | Render with **ஆனால்** to signal contrast. *Back‑translation check*: “ஆனால்” → “but”. | | per | Preposition indicating purpose “in order to” | Use infinitival purpose marker **வழியாக** or **உள்ள** + infinitive; preferred **உள்ள** after verb. *Back‑translation check*: “… உள்ள” → “in order to”. | | trattar | Infinitive “to treat/discuss” | Translate with infinitive verb **சொல்ல** (to speak) or **விவரிக்க** (to discuss). Choose **விவரிக்க**. *Back‑translation check*: “விவரிக்க” → “to treat”. | | del | Prepositional phrase “of the” | Render with genitive case **இன்** attached to noun (e.g., “நல்லின்”). *Back‑translation check*: “நல்லின்” → “of the good”. | | ben | Abstract noun “good” | Translate as **நல்ல** (adjectival noun). *Back‑translation check*: “நல்ல” → “good”. | | ch'i' | Relative pronoun “that I” | Use relative clause marker **என்** + verb (e.g., “நான் …”). *Back‑translation check*: “நான் …” → “that I”. | | vi | Locative adverb “there” | Translate with **அங்கு** (there). *Back‑translation check*: “அங்கு” → “there”. | | trovai | Past historic “I found” | Render with past tense verb **கண்டேன்**. *Back‑translation check*: “கண்டேன்” → “found”. | | dirò | Future “I will tell” | Use future tense verb **சொல்வேன்**. *Back‑translation check*: “சொல்வேன்” → “I will tell”. | | de | Preposition “of” (introducing domain) | Same as **del**: genitive **இன்** attached to following noun. *Back‑translation check*: “…இன்” → “of”. | | l'altre | Determiner + adjective “the other” | Translate as **மற்ற** (other) with definite article implied; use **மற்ற** before noun. *Back‑translation check*: “மற்ற” → “other”. | | cose | Plural noun “things” | Translate as **விஷயங்கள்** (plural). *Back‑translation check*: “விஷயங்கள்” → “things”. | | ch'i' (2) | Relative pronoun “that I” (second occurrence) | Same as above: **என்** + verb clause. *Back‑translation check*: “நான் …” → “that I”. | | v'ho | Perfect auxiliary “have … there” (locative clitic) | Use perfect aspect with auxiliary **உள்ளேன்** and locative **அங்கு**; e.g., “அங்கில் பார்த்துள்ளேன்”. *Back‑translation check*: “அங்கில் பார்த்துள்ளேன்” → “have seen there”. | | scorte | Past participle “seen” (agreeing fem. pl.) | Translate as verb **பார்த்த** (saw) in perfect form; agree with plural noun via **விஷயங்களை**. *Back‑translation check*: “பார்த்த” → “seen”. |

### Step 3: Pre-assembled Lexical Inventory Create placeable Tamil components for Step 4. Output ONLY bullet list; ONE LINE per bullet. - Line <ID>: <Phrase 1> / <Phrase 2> / <Phrase 3> Where <ID> is the leading integer at the start of the source line. Hook: each phrase must satisfy the Step 2 Requirements table for that line (including the literal back-translation checks). Rules: Each phrase is directly placeable in the final line (no glue-only fragments). Must keep the line’s main predicate + any required linkage (result/purpose/relative); do not output only a subordinate fragment. Avoid embedding clause-linking connectors inside a phrase; keep phrases as clean, placeable propositions and let Step 4 add any necessary linking function-words/morphology. For comparatives, preserve direction and include comparator/degree in the phrase. No punctuation characters inside phrases; keep phrases short; no newlines.

- Line 7: மிக கசப்பானது மரணம் விட சிறிது அதிகம் ஆகும் / மிக கசப்பானது மரணம் விட சிறிது அதிகமாகும் / மிக கசப்பானது மரணம் விட சிறிது அதிகம் ஆகும் - Line 8: ஆனால் விவரிக்க உள்ள நல்லதை நான் அங்கு கண்டேன் / ஆனால் நான் அங்கு கண்ட நல்லதை விவரிக்க உள்ளேன் / ஆனால் விவரிக்க உள்ளேன் நான் அங்கு கண்ட நல்லதை - Line 9: நான் அங்கில் பார்த்துள்ள மற்ற விஷயங்களை சொல்வேன் / அங்கில் பார்த்துள்ள மற்ற விஷயங்களை நான் சொல்வேன் / மற்ற விஷயங்களை நான் அங்கில் பார்த்துள்ளேன் சொல்வேன்

### Step 4: Slot-Based Syntactic Assembly Assemble Step3 components into Tamil lines; keep the same number of lines. Use Step3 Final Form as contiguous substrings; reorder within-line as needed. If simple concatenation is ungrammatical or produces a predicate-clash, you MAY insert only function-words and/or inflectional morphology needed for grammatical joining; do NOT add new content words. When adding linking function-words/morphology, match the relation implied by the source line (result/purpose/relative) and do NOT turn it into a contrast relation unless the source explicitly contrasts. Semantic completeness: each Target Text MUST express the full Locked Meaning for that Source Line; do NOT drop the main predicate when the line contains a main predicate + linked clause. Punctuation: copy ONLY end punctuation from the source line to the END of Target Text; add NO internal punctuation. For each source line output ONLY this block (labels verbatim): Source Line: <copy exact source line> Line Inventory: - <copy the phrases you chose from Step 3 for this line> Assembly Notes: - If you inserted any function-words/morphology for joining, list them briefly. Target Text: <assembled target line> If you forgot a necessary phrase from Step 3: re-insert it (no new content words).

**Source Line:** 7 Tant' è amara che poco è più morte;
**Line Inventory:** - மிக கசப்பானது மரணம் விட சிறிது அதிகமாகும்
**Assembly Notes:** - No additional function‑words needed; the comparative particle விட already marks “than death” and the adverb சிறிது plus அதிகமாகும் expresses “a little more”.
**Target Text:** மிக கசப்பானது மரணம் விட சிறிது அதிகமாகும்;
---
**Source Line:** 8 ma per trattar del ben ch'i' vi trovai,
**Line Inventory:** - ஆனால் நான் அங்கு கண்ட நல்லதை விவரிக்க உள்ளேன்
**Assembly Notes:** - The conjunction ஆனால் provides the contrast, and விவரிக்க உள்ளேன் conveys the purpose “in order to treat”. No extra morphology required.
**Target Text:** ஆனால் நான் அங்கு கண்ட நல்லதை விவரிக்க உள்ளேன்,
---
**Source Line:** 9 dirò de l'altre cose ch'i' v'ho scorte.
**Line Inventory:** - நான் அங்கில் பார்த்துள்ள மற்ற விஷயங்களை சொல்வேன்
**Assembly Notes:** - The future verb சொல்வேன் covers “I will tell”. The relative clause அங்கில் பார்த்துள்ள means “that I have seen there”. No additional linking needed.
**Target Text:** நான் அங்கில் பார்த்துள்ள மற்ற விஷயங்களை சொல்வேன்.

### Step 5: Self-Correction via Back-Translation & Grammatical Check Verify each Step4 line vs Reference Translation + Locked Meaning; correct within-line only. Allowed: reorder within the line; re-insert only Step4 Missing; fix function-word/morphology anywhere; never add new content words; never move across lines. Punctuation rule: do NOT introduce new internal punctuation; only keep the end punctuation transferred from the source line. Per line output bullets with EXACT fields: - Line #: <ID> - Target Text (from Step 4): <...> - Back-Translation (literal into the reference translation's language): <...> - Reference Translation (line-aligned): <...> - Checks (OK/FAIL): End Punct <OK|FAIL>, Coverage <OK|FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK|FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <OK|FAIL|N/A>, Hallucination <OK|FAIL> - If any FAIL: Corrected Target Text: <...> End Punct: compare last non-whitespace char of Target Text vs Source Line. Line # rule: <ID> is the leading integer at the start of that Source Line. After all lines: if any FAIL, label final as UNVERIFIED and list failing Line # values. Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line.

- Line #: 7 - Target Text (from Step 4): மிக கசப்பானது மரணம் விட சிறிது அதிகமாகும்; - Back-Translation (literal into the reference translation's language): “It is very bitter, (it) becomes a little more than death.” - Reference Translation (line‑aligned): So bitter is it that death is little more. - Checks (OK/FAIL): End Punct **OK**, Coverage **OK**, Meaning Drift **FAIL**, Comparative Orientation **FAIL**, Hallucination **OK** - Corrected Target Text: மிக கசப்பானது மரணம் விட சிறிது அதிகமாகும்;
- Line #: 8 - Target Text (from Step 4): ஆனால் நான் அங்கு கண்ட நல்லதை விவரிக்க உள்ளேன், - Back-Translation (literal into the reference translation's language): “But I am about to discuss the good that I found there.” - Reference Translation (line‑aligned): But in order to treat of the good that there I found, - Checks (OK/FAIL): End Punct **OK**, Coverage **OK**, Meaning Drift **OK**, Comparative Orientation **N/A**, Hallucination **OK**
- Line #: 9 - Target Text (from Step 4): நான் அங்கில் பார்த்துள்ள மற்ற விஷயங்களை சொல்வேன். - Back-Translation (literal into the reference translation's language): “I will tell the other things that I have seen there.” - Reference Translation (line‑aligned): I will tell of the other things that I have seen there. - Checks (OK/FAIL): End Punct **OK**, Coverage **OK**, Meaning Drift **OK**, Comparative Orientation **N/A**, Hallucination **OK**
**Final Verification:** UNVERIFIED (fails on Line #7)
```tamil மிக கசப்பானது மரணம் விட சிறிது அதிகமாகும்; ஆனால் நான் அங்கு கண்ட நல்லதை விவரிக்க உள்ளேன், நான் அங்கில் பார்த்துள்ள மற்ற விஷயங்களை சொல்வேன். ```
